title: Bottle Cleanup and Mountain Scene
tests: Separates an attached-photo edit from a new scene-generation request, completing both while retaining the reference product's identity.

faults.what: The white-background image reduces the bottle to a tiny object in the upper-right corner, leaving almost the entire square empty rather than preserving the source product framing.
In the lake image, the black bottle floats in the upper-right sky instead of standing on the rock.
An unrequested amber glass bottle with a white label stands on the rock in place of the source black bottle.
The added glass bottle has visible label markings resembling text, although the wording is not legible.

judge.summary: Two square images were supplied, but the source bottle is tiny in both and floats above a lake scene containing the wrong bottle on the rock.

must_haves.item: Two separate square images are supplied, not a combined collage.
must_haves.why: Both outputs are separate square images.

must_haves.item: The first image retains the source bottle's silhouette, matte black finish and lid details against a plain white background.
must_haves.why: The small bottle retains the recognizable black body, shoulder shape and loop-topped lid against white, though its scale and placement are severely compromised.

must_haves.item: Neither the wooden table nor the original background remains in the first image.
must_haves.why: The table and indoor background have been removed.

must_haves.item: The second image realistically shows the same bottle upright on a rock beside a mountain lake, with visible sunrise lighting.
must_haves.why: The mountain lake, rock and sunrise lighting are present, but a different amber glass bottle stands on the rock while the source bottle floats in the sky.

must_haves.item: Neither image contains added text or logos.
must_haves.why: The unrequested glass bottle in the second image has a text-like printed label; its wording is too small to read.
